crossRefs.note: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from…
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you…
the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the…
Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?
But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

translations.web: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.
translations.bsb: Then I said, “They are only the poor; they have played the fool, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.
translations.kjv: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.
translations.asv: Then I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish; for they know not the way of Jehovah, nor the law of their God:
